Question_Text: What is the average time complexity of searching in a balanced Binary Search Tree (BST)?
Explanation: In a balanced BST, tree height is log n, yielding O(log n) search time.

Question_Text: Which SQL keyword is utilized to filter results after an aggregation function has been evaluated?
Explanation: The HAVING clause filters aggregated group records, whereas WHERE filters individual rows prior to grouping.

Question_Text: What output is generated by executing: int a=5, b=2; float c=(float)(a/b); printf('%.1f', c); in C?
Explanation: Integer division (5/2) evaluates to 2 before explicit cast to float occurs.

Question_Text: In Case Study 1, why is Redis DECR preferred over a standard read-modify-write cycle for inventory deduction?
Option_A: Redis runs in multi-threaded kernel space
Option_B: Redis DECR executes as an atomic single-threaded operation preventing overselling
Option_C: Redis automatically rolls back relational transactions
Explanation: Redis single-threaded command execution guarantees atomicity without race conditions.
